framing_disclaimer: This tool measures DOCUMENTED READINESS and RISK EXPOSURE. It does NOT predict the case officer's decision and is not legal/migration advice. Always verify current figures on the Department of Home Affairs website before lodging.

config.note: Figures change without notice. The tool MUST re-display 'confirm on the Department page on lodgement day'. Pakistan = Assessment Level 3 since 8 Jan 2026: full financial + academic + English documentation required.

score_bands.label: Strong Readiness
score_bands.description: Your documented file is well-prepared with low visible risk. This is NOT a prediction or guarantee of a visa grant — the case officer decides. Re-verify figures and lodge with confidence once any minor items are closed.

score_bands.label: Moderate Risk — Improve Before Lodging
score_bands.description: Eligible but with visible weak points that EL3 officers will probe. Close the flagged items before lodging to avoid avoidable refusal.

score_bands.label: High Refusal Risk
score_bands.description: Serious gaps present. Lodging now indicates serious unresolved readiness issues that EL3 scrutiny will expose. Resolve all high-risk flags first.

score_bands.label: Critical Refusal Risk
score_bands.description: Mandatory requirements missing or integrity flags present. Do not lodge — critical items are missing or unresolved — Proceeding risks a PIC 4020 exclusion if anything is misrepresented.

tiers.hard_blocker: Any triggered hard blocker forces result = 'Critical Refusal Risk'. Score calculation is skipped. These are legally mandatory items or integrity grounds.
tiers.high_risk_flag: Each triggered high-risk flag deducts its impact AND caps the maximum achievable band. Caps: 1-2 flags => max band 'High Refusal Risk'; 3+ flags => 'Critical Refusal Risk'. This prevents proportional averaging from hiding serious risk behind an otherwise clean file.
tiers.soft_warning: Each triggered soft warning deducts its impact within the band but does not cap the band. Surfaced as 'improve before lodging'.

calculation_logic.step_1: Evaluate hard blockers. If ANY triggers -> result 'Critical Refusal Risk'; stop.
calculation_logic.step_2: For each category: category_score = (sum of score_impact for PASSING questions / sum of score_impact for ALL scored questions in category) x max_points. 'info' questions with trigger_if=never are excluded from pass/fail and contribute only routing.
calculation_logic.step_3: total_score = sum of category scores, rounded to nearest integer.
calculation_logic.step_4: Count triggered high-risk flags. Apply band cap: 1-2 => cap at 'High Refusal Risk'; 3+ => 'Critical Refusal Risk'.
calculation_logic.step_5: Map total_score to a band, then apply the band cap (final band = the worse of score-band and cap-band).
calculation_logic.passing_definition: A question PASSES when the user's answer satisfies its pass_if condition. Computed financial pass is funds >= tuition + 29710 + 2500 + dependant additions.
calculation_logic.rounding: Category scores to 1 decimal; total to nearest integer.

result_payload_template.label: <band label>
result_payload_template.estimated_refusal_concerns: <list of triggered hard blockers + high-risk flags, plain English>
result_payload_template.recommended_improvements: <soft warnings + how to close each flag>
result_payload_template.priority_action_list: <ordered: hard blockers first, then high-risk flags, then soft warnings>
result_payload_template.disclaimer: This is a readiness assessment, not a visa-approval prediction or legal advice. Verify all figures at immi.homeaffairs.gov.au before lodging.

critical_blockers_hard.message: You cannot lodge a Subclass 500 without a valid CoE from a CRICOS-registered provider. An offer letter is NOT a CoE — the CoE is issued after you accept and pay the deposit.
The exact CoE number must be entered during lodgement. Keep the PDF from your provider handy.
Packaged courses (common for pathway/foundation programs) need a CoE for each stage at lodgement.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required
critical_blockers_hard.message: Many Pakistani students are mis-sold by agents into non-CRICOS providers. Verify the provider yourself on the official CRICOS register before paying anything.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required
critical_blockers_hard.message: The exact course must be CRICOS-registered, not only the university. Search your course title on the CRICOS register.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required
critical_blockers_hard.message: Subclass 500 requires full-time study. Part-time enrolment is not eligible.

Since March 2024 the old GTE statement is replaced by GS questions answered directly in the form (ties at home, why this course/Australia, course-career benefit, plus any relevant facts). Weak/generic GS answers are the No.1 refusal reason for Pakistani applicants.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
critical_blockers_hard.message: Minimum = first-year tuition + AUD 29,710 living costs + ~AUD 2,500 airfare (plus extra for any dependants). Funds must be genuine and accessible, not just a number on paper.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
critical_blockers_hard.message: This is the core financial-capacity test. Under-funding is a top refusal cause. Use current figures — the living cost rose from 24,505 to 29,710 in 2024.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
critical_blockers_hard.message: Add ~AUD 10,394 for a partner and ~AUD 4,449 per child to your required funds. Under-funding dependants invalidates the financial test.
OSHC is mandatory and must be from an approved Australian provider. Pakistani/local health insurance is NOT accepted.
Only the five approved Australian OSHC providers count. Verify before paying.
Cover must span your whole visa period, starting ~1 week before classes. Gaps in OSHC breach visa conditions.
A valid result is required unless genuinely exempt. Minimum IELTS 5.5 overall for the visa; your course often needs higher (6.0–7.0).
Meeting the visa floor (IELTS 5.5) is not enough if your university needs 6.5. Both must be satisfied.
A health exam is mandatory. Pakistani applicants almost always need a chest X-ray for TB screening.
Only exams at approved panel clinics count. A cheaper local clinic's report is worthless for the visa and wastes money.
Pakistani applicants typically need a PCC from NADRA/local police; add clearances for any other country of long residence.
Hiding a character issue is an independent refusal ground — worse than the issue itself. Disclose everything.
Non-disclosure of immigration history is an independent refusal ground and can trigger a re-entry ban (PIC 4020). Disclose everything, even old/minor matters.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Course Must Be at the Same or Higher AQF Level (Condition 8202)
critical_blockers_hard.message: Dropping to a lower AQF level on the same visa breaches Condition 8202 and risks cancellation. You'd need a new Subclass 500.

high_risk_flags.message: Vague ties ('my family is here') are weak. Strong ties are documentable: ancestral property in your name, a written return job offer, a family business you are part of, dependants relying on you.
Officers reject generic reasons. Name the specific units, faculty, accreditation, or industry link that maps to YOUR background and a Pakistan-based career outcome.
Show the path: current background → this course → a named role/sector in Pakistan. A course with no logical career payoff at home signals migration intent.
EL3 officers probe 'why spend this much?'. Have a defensible reason tied to course quality/accreditation — not lifestyle or work rights.
A drastic, unexplained field change (e.g. MBBS → hospitality) is a classic refusal trigger. If you are switching, your GS answer must explain it credibly.
Provide employment letters, salary slips, freelance/contract proof, or transcripts covering the gap years. 'I was preparing' without proof is weak.
A large field switch is allowed but heavily scrutinised at EL3. If yes, your GS answers must connect old and new fields with a credible career story.
EL3 requires authenticated academic documents. Get HEC attestation for degrees and IBCC for FSc/Matric where applicable; provide certified English translations.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
high_risk_flags.message: EL3 expects a settled balance history (~3 months minimum). Unlike the UK there is no fixed 28-day rule, but a long consistent balance beats a recent lump sum every time.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
high_risk_flags.message: Erratic statements (empty for months, then suddenly full) signal arranged funds and trigger verification calls to your bank.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
high_risk_flags.message: EL3's core test. Each major deposit needs proof: registered sale deed for property, FBR-declared salary, sanctioned loan letter, or a notarised gift affidavit from a traceable giver.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
high_risk_flags.message: A sponsor showing large funds but no FBR tax history is a major red flag — it implies undeclared/untraceable income. Sponsor's declared income should plausibly support the amount.
Prior refusals (especially UK/Canada/USA) are visible to Australia and heavily scrutinised. A refusal is survivable IF disclosed and explained — concealment is fatal.
An asylum claim history strongly conflicts with 'temporary student returning home' and must be addressed candidly with legal advice if it applies.
Unscrupulous agents inflate bank balances, fake experience letters, or alter transcripts. If an agent fabricated anything, YOU face refusal and a PIC 4020 ban. Verify every line yourself.

soft_warnings.message: Subclass 500 applicants are usually 6+ for school sectors and 18+ for higher education. This is informational and rarely a problem for university applicants.
Attach what you can: property papers, family business registration, a conditional return job letter. Documents beat narrative.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
soft_warnings.message: Immediate-family sponsorship is expected and trusted. Distant relatives or 'family friends' as sponsors raise scrutiny and need a strong relationship + funds-source explanation.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
soft_warnings.message: Property-sale funding is fine if the sale deed is registered and money entered the account through the banking channel — not cash.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
soft_warnings.message: Education loans are accepted with a formal sanction letter from a recognised financial institution. Informal/family loans are not the same and carry less weight.
The visa charge (~AUD 2,000 per primary applicant) is paid at lodgement and is separate from your evidence-of-funds. Confirm the current charge before lodging.
The HAP ID lets you book the medical. Generate it early — panel-clinic slots in Pakistan can be limited.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Work Limited to 48 Hours Per Fortnight During Study
soft_warnings.message: Work is capped at 48 hours/fortnight while classes are in session (unlimited during scheduled breaks). Breaching it risks cancellation.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Must Maintain Full-Time Enrolment and Satisfactory Academic Progress
soft_warnings.message: Condition 8202: maintain full-time enrolment and progress. Failing this is a common cause of cancellation for students who treat study as secondary.
Prefer agents authorised by your institution or a registered migration agent. 'Guaranteed visa' middlemen are the source of most fraud-related refusals.
